title: Show authorized inventory-movement page distribution by warehouse and status
description: An inventory user groups the currently authorized dynamic movement report page by warehouse, stagnant classification, or ledger-history status and sees a visual count distribution. Reuse ERP-130 stock-query menu authorization, existing warehouse/product/date filters and bounded report service. Count rows only; never sum quantities across different products or base units, infer missing movement history, or estimate cost. Invalid group keys fail closed; existing HTTP audit records read-only requests. Development only: no Domain/schema change, migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify unit and Node logic tests plus safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: API accepts only none/warehouse/classification/history grouping and returns deterministic row counts from the same authorized current preview page; no quantities across unlike units are summed.
Designer renders an accessible labeled count chart for the selected group, including empty and unknown-history categories; pagination changes recompute page-only counts.
Unit and Node tests cover warehouse grouping, classification and unknown history, empty page, invalid group key, permission and safe rendering; document page-only count semantics.
